trace.cypher: MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team) WHERE t.team_name <> 'Golden State Warriors' AND o.birth_date IS NOT NULL WITH o, t, CAST(DATE_PART('year', DATE('2026-10-14')) - DATE_PART('year', DATE(o.birth_date)) - CASE WHEN DATE_PART('month', DATE(o.birth_date)) > DATE_PART('month', DATE('2026-10-14')) OR (DATE_PART('month', DATE(o.birth_date)) = DATE_PART('month', DATE('2026-10-14')) AND DATE_PART('day', DATE(o.birth_date)) > DATE_PART('day', DATE('2026-10-14'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT64) AS age WHERE age >= 67 RETURN DISTINCT age AS col1, t.team_name AS col2, o.name AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
